actions_or_findings.title: NON_BLOCKING: Refresh stale-session blocker closed

actions_or_findings.rationale: The locked reread now uses populate_existing, so SQLAlchemy refreshes the cached session before checking revocation. The reverse-refresh evidence reports AUTH.INVALID_TOKEN and no successor. This matches [SQLAlchemy’s documented behavior](https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/20/orm/queryguide/api.html).

actions_or_findings.trigger: Logout discovers an old session while phone change holds the user lock.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Logout now locks the user before locking and refreshing the session, then returns idempotently if it was revoked. The MySQL race evidence reports completion without deadlock. Refresh, revoke, and session issue also take the user lock before session locks or insertion.
